note: PLAYERS pane of the admin window: who is in the Zone on the left, the permadeath form on the right. Created by OZ_VppMenu.OnCreate under OZ_VppRoot at [0, vpp.paneY], exactly where every other pane creates itself, so all of them overlap and the script shows one at a time. Names PlrList, PlrUid, PlrHint and BtnPlrWipe are read by OZ_VppMenu.c. The caption runs the full width under both columns rather than inside the 460-unit form: it is one long sentence, a label is a single line, and a column-wide one would be cut. The wording is deliberately POORER than the FACTIONS pane's: this pane exists on a server with nothing but the core, where 'private chats are left' and 'roles reset to novice' would be false.
